name: imax-3d-simulator-android
description: Interactive browser-based 3D IMAX and ScreenX virtual cinema simulator, with Android APK packaging.

scripts.android:init: npm run build:web && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run build:web && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
